components.css: .ds-recovery{display:flex;width:min(100%,352px);max-height:calc(100vh - 40px);flex-direction:column;gap:10px;overflow-y:auto;padding:16px;border-radius:16px;background:#151515;box-shadow:var(--shadow);color:var(--text-primary)}.ds-heading{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:9px}.ds-mark{display:grid;width:26px;height:26px;flex:0 0 auto;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-strong);font-weight:700}.ds-heading>div{min-width:0;flex:1}.ds-title{margin:0;font:600 12px/1.4 Manrope,-apple-system,sans-serif}.ds-message{margin:3px 0 0;color:var(--text-secondary);font:400 10px/1.35 Manrope,-apple-system,sans-serif}.ds-dismiss{width:28px;height:28px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:transparent;color:var(--accent-strong)}.ds-dismiss:hover{background:var(--accent-soft)}.ds-dismiss:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}.ds-excerpt{max-height:4.2em;overflow:hidden;padding:8px 9px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--surface) 65%,transparent)}.ds-excerpt p{display:-webkit-box;margin:0;overflow:hidden;font:400 11px/1.4 Manrope,-apple-system,sans-serif;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:3}.ds-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end}.ds-copy{min-height:34px;padding:0 11px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;background:var(--surface-muted);color:var(--text-primary);font:600 12px/1 Manrope,-apple-system,sans-serif}.ds-copy:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--surface-muted) 78%,var(--text-primary) 22%)}.ds-copy:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview:
Voco pairs a wide desktop dashboard with a guided first run. Home shows readiness, the Fn / Globe shortcut, and the optional latest transcript. Settings hold model, access, shortcut, and transcript controls. A separate four-step setup takes a new user from welcome to a first dictation.

Black surfaces and fine gray borders carry the interface. Orange marks actions, the wordmark, and voice activity. Manrope handles interface text, with Instrument Serif on selected headline lines. The black app tile and orange waveform repeat the same mark. The floating pill stays compact while dictation runs and shows transcript text only when recovery needs attention.
keyCharacteristics: Black and gray surfaces with a restrained orange accent.
Wide dashboard and guided first-run setup.
Manrope interface text with selective Instrument Serif headlines.
Optional latest transcript held in memory until quit.

rules.name: The Restrained Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep orange on actions, the wordmark, focus, and voice activity. Large surfaces stay black or neutral gray.

rules.name: The Wide Workspace Rule
rules.body: Keep the dashboard and setup content open on desktop. Stack their columns only at the implemented responsive breakpoints.

dos: Do use black surfaces, fine gray borders, and orange for actions and voice activity.
Do keep blue and red for readiness and error feedback.
Do keep the dashboard, setup flow, and flat settings groups distinct.
Do retain keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do show latest transcript text only when the optional in-memory setting is on, or when recovery needs a copy action.
donts: Don't add neon grids, glow effects, or Tron-style panels.
Don't add persistent transcript history or save audio and transcript text to disk.
Don't show partial transcript text or a Buffered badge during capture.
Don't add cards or shadows to settings groups.
Don't make browser preview imply that native actions are active.
